newsitem.title: TURKEY: Istanbul gold firms, volume higher.
newsitem.headline: Istanbul gold firms, volume higher.

text.p: Istanbul gold exchange trade picked up slightly on Tuesday with volume rising to 740 kilos, from Monday's 387 kilos on physical demand, dealers said.
Gold closed firmer at $350.00 an ounce and 1,466,200 lira per gram versus $347.50 and 1,453,500 lira on Monday on expectations of firmer levels in European markets.
The Turkish currency closed at 130,440 lira to the dollar, compared to 129,770 on Friday.
Of the day's trade, 210 kilos of gold changed hands in the morning session and 530 kilos in the afternoon, 71.6 percent of trade was conducted in lira terms.
